overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to three OML complaints within 14 days and by referring them to Town Counsel without Board review; ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board failed to review and respond to their Open Meeting Law complaints within the 14-day deadline.
allegations.key_passage: The Board did not respond to these complaints at all, which violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Chair referred OML complaints to Town Counsel without the Board first reviewing them or voting to authorize counsel to act.
allegations.key_passage: Proper procedure would have been for the Board to review the complaints before authorizing legal counsel to respond on its behalf.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
